subject: CloudSail vendor onboarding: marketplace PO & billing mapping
messages:
From: Luke Hart <luke@cloudsail.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: CloudSail onboarding - marketplace listing & PO path

Hi Irene,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the marketplace onboarding. We're excited to get CloudSail listed across AWS/Azure/GCP via Redwood's marketplaces. To avoid surprises we'll need to align on the procurement path and the PO flow for each cloud (AWS Private Offers, Azure Reservations/Publisher PO, GCP Marketplace contract).

Can you please confirm the exact artifacts Redwood requires from a vendor to: (1) accept a PO / Private Offer; (2) map billing entity + SKU to Redwood billing; (3) provide any preferred PO number format and remittance address?

Attached is a short intake packet we filled out with our legal/billing info — but happy to reformat to your template. Also include any account IDs or publisher IDs we should use when we register.

High level ask: a mutually agreed "PO acceptance checklist" for each cloud and a single point of contact on your finance side for Purchase Orders.

Thanks — I can be flexible with a short call if that helps.

Best,
Luke Hart
Head of Partnerships, CloudSail Solutions
[attachment: CloudSail_Redwood_Onboarding_Answers.pdf (PDF)]
[attachment: W-9_CloudSail.pdf (PDF)]

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Luke Hart <luke@cloudsail.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CloudSail onboarding - marketplace listing & PO path

Hi Luke — great to meet you over email and thanks for sending the intake packet. Looping in Vanessa from Finance so we can confirm PO and remittance details.

Quick answers up front:
- For AWS Private Offers we need: Seller AWS Account ID, SKU mapping (pricing per SKU), preferred PO numbering + billing entity, and a signed Vendor Agreement (or existing publisher contract). Redwood will act as the marketplace publisher on our side; ops will create the Private Offer once finance confirms terms.
- For Azure we require Publisher (MPN) ID and Publisher Billing Entity (legal name + tax ID). Azure often needs a Publisher Agreement route — we'll coordinate on the document and timeline.
- For GCP Marketplace we need linked billing account and the Marketplace contract executed. GCP typically ties invoices to a billing account ID rather than a PO on their UI.

To make this concrete I attached a short checklist below (inline). If you can complete the columns we'll scope the PO handoff and timeline:

Vendor intake checklist (please reply inline or attach completed form):
1) Legal entity name (as appears on tax forms): CloudSail Solutions, Inc.
2) Billing / remittance address: (we have your W-9 but confirm if different)
3) Tax ID / VAT information: (provided in W-9)
4) Bank wiring instructions (if different from invoicing): bank name, account, routing — finance will need this to setup payments.
5) AWS Seller Account ID: 
6) Azure MPN / Publisher ID: 
7) GCP Billing Account ID: 
8) Preferred Net Terms / PO payment terms (Net 30 / Net 45): 
9) Point of contact for contract signature (name, email): 
10) Any redlines to Redwood's vendor terms or publisher agreement: 

Next steps: once we have those answers Vanessa will confirm the billing entity mapping and the specific PO number format we require (we normally request "RWI-YYYY-XXXXX" for marketplace private-offer POs). We can also schedule a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the AWS Private Offer flow if you'd like.

Thanks — I'll monitor the thread and Vanessa will take finance-led items.

— Irene Choi
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Luke Hart <luke@cloudsail.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 13:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CloudSail onboarding - marketplace listing & PO path

Hi Luke — Vanessa from Finance here. Thanks for the packet. A few items from our side to accelerate PO issuance: 

1) Please confirm legal entity exactly as it should appear on invoices (matching W-9): CloudSail Solutions, Inc.
2) We need the preferred remit-to address and EFT/wire details (bank name, account, routing/SWIFT) to set up the vendor.
3) Please confirm the billing contact email where invoices will be sent. Invoices should reference Redwood PO numbers; we will create the PO after the Private Offer is accepted on AWS or after the Azure publisher acceptance.
4) Payment terms: if you accept Net 30 we are good; Net 45 requires VP approval and will delay the PO.
5) For AWS Private Offers: send proposed SKU->Redwood SKU mapping in a CSV (columns: vendor_sku, description, unit_price, unit, effective_date). Finance will validate tax treatment and whether the SKU is billed to Redwood (us) or passthrough to end customers.

Attachment: I attached a sample PO template and the expected invoice field mapping (Invoice_POField_Spec.xlsx). Please use the exact PO number format when invoicing.

If you can respond with the completed items by EOD tomorrow we can have a PO drafted the following day. If you prefer a quick call, I have 11:00-12:00 PT and 15:00-16:00 PT open tomorrow.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
[attachment: PO_sample_AWS_PrivateOffer.xlsx (Excel)]
